subject: [PATCH v4 04/14] SUNRPC: bound the local rpcbind client timeout to 1s

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch limits the timeout for local rpcbind client connections to 1 second. The previous default timeouts of 10 seconds and 60 seconds were causing stalls in NFS server operations, leading to hung-task watchdog warnings. By bounding the timeout to a single attempt of 1 second, the patch reduces the duration of these stalls, but does not eliminate them entirely. A more comprehensive fix would involve making the registration process asynchronous. The change affects the kernel's local rpcbind client, which communicates with the local rpcbind service over loopback or AF_LOCAL sockets.
